patch_description: Crosses the multi-candidate lattice enumeration from the first program with the hexagonal lattice relaxation of the second. Enumerates several staggered/square row layouts across multiple lattice spacings, relaxes each with a fully vectorized pairwise repulsion (instead of the slow O(n^2) Python loops), computes maximum radii with a vectorized proportional-scaling loop, and returns the best configuration by total radii. This keeps the speed of program 1's vectorization while ensuring the candidate selection and scoring work correctly (program 1's low score came from evaluating candidates with an effective radius that collapsed radii), and improves over program 2's single layout by trying many topologies.
